altar:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished transparent game sprite for Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup, an altar for Vellum the Archbinder.
Create ONE original 32-by-32 logical-pixel tile, rendered large with perfectly crisp nearest-neighbor square pixels, not an illustration or scene.
Subject: a small dark plum stone altar on a two-tier stepped plinth, seen in classic Crawl oblique top-down view. A thick ivory parchment codex rests open on the altar, its pages tied and stitched with glowing magenta-violet enchanted threads. One oversized slender golden bookbinder's needle stands diagonally through the binding. Two clear looping strands arc around the codex. Vellum transfers whole enchantments between artifacts by binding conserved magical threads, so the visual identity is an arcane bookbinder, precise and mysterious.
Palette: near-black plum outlines, muted purple-grey stone, warm ivory parchment, antique gold needle, saturated magenta thread and small lavender highlights; limited 16-color pixel-art palette.
Composition: entire object fits inside a centered square with about 2 logical pixels transparent padding. Strong compact silhouette, readable at actual 32px size. Upper-left highlight, deep lower-right shading, isolated transparent background.
Constraints: authentic low-resolution dungeon roguelike item sprite. Hard square pixel clusters, no smooth outlines, no gradients, no anti-aliasing, no drop shadow outside the sprite, no floor, no room, no characters, no lettering, no watermark, no frame, no labels, no sprite sheet. Actual transparent alpha background.
weave:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished transparent 32-by-32 logical-pixel game ability icon for Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup: Vellum's Weave Enchantments.
Create ONE simple low-resolution pixel-art icon, enlarged with crisp square pixels. Its entire design should be legible after reduction to just 32x32 actual pixels.
Subject: one large antique-gold bookbinder's needle, slanting bottom-left to top-right, piercing a small folded ivory parchment strip in the center. A single thick luminous magenta thread runs through the needle's eye, loops once around the parchment, and curls into a compact infinity-like binding knot. Two tiny lavender sparks. The motif is binding and transferring magical enchantments.
Style: authentic restrained old-school dungeon roguelike UI sprite with deliberately LARGE pixel clusters and simplified symbolic shapes. Just needle, folded parchment, and thread. No book, no altar, no other objects.
Palette: limited 12-color palette, dark plum outline and shadow, ivory parchment, antique gold, strong magenta and pale lavender highlights.
Composition: isolated centered compact square silhouette, transparent 2 logical-pixel margin. No circular badge, no tile frame, no floor, no smooth gradients, no anti-aliasing, no text or runes, no watermark. Genuine transparent alpha background.
